## Proposed change
This PR implements the changes @MartinHjelmare requested after PR #51952 was merged into dev. There two exceptions from this due to mypy validation errors:
1. In `get_all_mc_entities` we have to check, if the entity is a MusicCastMediaPlayer, otherwise the returned list is of type MusicCastDeviceEntity. Of course we could remove or change the return type from that method, but this would lower the maintainability in my opinion. mypy error:
    `List comprehension has incompatible type List[MusicCastDeviceEntity]; expected List[MusicCastMediaPlayer]`
2. In `is_server` we have to use the len(xxx)>0 pattern because we build a boolean value from this. mypy error:
    `Incompatible return value type (got "Union[bool, Any, List[Any]]", expected "bool")`

In addition, some refactoring for multi_zone devices in groups was done. Therefore the aiomusiccast library was updated. 

This also fixes an issue, which can occur, when using the official musiccast app to create or update groups. Until now it was possible that our integration was that fast in performing checks for the integrity of the groups that the musiccast App did not finish the grouping procedure before this integration restored the old, working group configuration.

Meanwhile @WizBangCrash opened #53406, which is fixed by this PR as he confirmed in the issue.

Hey there @vigonotion, mind taking a look at this pull request as its been labeled with an integration (`yamaha_musiccast`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L575) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

For now we should also move this to `async_added_to_hass` and remove the entity from the list when we remove the entity.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/4a94ed8f5a2b99da7b771bf740e5dc67349fc8b1/homeassistant/components/yamaha_musiccast/media_player.py#L151

For the future, we should think about if there's a better interface to the group api than storing the entities in a shared list. Generally that's a pattern we want to avoid since it promotes error prone use of the entity interface.

> For now we should also move this to `async_added_to_hass` and remove the entity from the list when we remove the entity.
> 
> https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/4a94ed8f5a2b99da7b771bf740e5dc67349fc8b1/homeassistant/components/yamaha_musiccast/media_player.py#L151
> 
> For the future, we should think about if there's a better interface to the group api than storing the entities in a shared list. Generally that's a pattern we want to avoid since it promotes error prone use of the entity interface.

Sorry for the delay - I figured out some problems with grouping on multi zone devices as well as a very rare issue with the official musiccast App while HA was running. Both should now be fixed as well as I made the adjustment, you proposed.

Regarding the proposal of removing the entities list from the coordinator, I totally agree with you - we should find another solution for that. I know that we could browse the entity registry for that, but from what I can see it wouldn't be a good idea to do that from properties... Do you have an idea, how we could do that?
